project_summary: A startup making a B2B SaaS product for mid-market customers.

action_map.success_metric: All 4 features shipped on time with 0 P0 bugs.
action_map.next_action: If pass: continue. If fail: cut scope to 2 features per month.

action_map.minimum_test: Run 20 customer discovery calls in 3 weeks.
action_map.success_metric: 10 of 20 prospects ask for a follow-up demo.
action_map.failure_threshold: Fewer than 4 of 20 prospects show interest.
action_map.next_action: If pass: build MVP. If fail: change ICP.

action_map.minimum_test: Build a feature matrix vs. top 5 competitors and survey 30 prospects.
action_map.success_metric: At least 60% of prospects rate our value prop above competitors.
action_map.next_action: If pass: ship. If fail: rework positioning.
